preferences.name: openrouterModel
preferences.description: OpenRouter model ID used by all commands unless a command overrides it
preferences.title: Model ID

preferences.name: reasoningEffort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: How much the model reasons before answering. "Model Default" sends nothing and keeps each model’s own default. Models without reasoning ignore it.

preferences.name: providerOrder
preferences.title: Provider Order
preferences.description: Comma-separated OpenRouter provider slugs to try first, in order (copy them from a model page). Region-specific endpoints like google-vertex/europe are used only when listed here. Slugs that do not serve the model are skipped.

preferences.name: providerFallbacks
preferences.title: Provider Fallbacks
preferences.label: Fall back to other providers
preferences.description: When the listed providers are unavailable or do not serve the model, let OpenRouter use any other provider. Turn off to use only the listed providers (requests fail instead).

preferences.name: openrouterSmartModel
preferences.description: OpenRouter model ID for "Retry with Smartest Model" (⇧⌘R). Leave empty to hide the action.
preferences.title: Smartest Model
